title: هجوم — بلاغ UKMTO 215-26 عن إصابة ناقلة بمقذوف في مؤخرتها على بعد 11 ميلًا بحريًا شمال خصب · 21/11/2026
source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 215-26 - ATTACK Incident Date 21 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 0500UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM north of Khasab, Oman. A Tanker transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz has been hit on the stern by an unknown projectile. There are no reported casualties at this time. Environmental impact is currently unconfirmed.
official_ref_basis: معرّف رسمي من نصّ المصدر: UKMTO-215-26
area_basis: نص البلاغ: 11NM north of Khasab, Oman، في عبور خارج من مضيق هرمز.
outcome: إصابة في مؤخرة الناقلة؛ لا إصابات، والأثر البيئي غير مؤكد.

title: هجوم — بلاغ UKMTO 216-26 عن إصابة ناقلة بمقذوف في غرفة المحركات على بعد 17 ميلًا بحريًا شرق خصب · 21/11/2026
source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 216-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 21 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 0550UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 17NM east of Khasab, Oman. A Tanker transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz has been hit in the engine room by an unknown projectile. There are no reported casualties at this time.
